display.purpose: The greeting only. Uppercase, one line filling the hero column (11.2cqi, fallback clamp(2.6rem, 10.4vw, 7.8rem)); two lines at 19.4cqi, line-height 1.02, at 40rem and below.

headline.purpose: The question in each log row. Sentence case, balanced.

headline-contact.purpose: The email address in the contact block, underlined at 0.07em.

lede.purpose: First paragraph of the letter and of About; each story's one-line summary (max 34ch).

body.purpose: Running text. 36rem columns for the letter and About, 66ch in stories.

body-small.purpose: Values in the story metadata column.

label.purpose: Anything that counts, labels or names: nav, section rule heads, row numbers, project names, metadata keys, tech lists (0.7rem), strip captions, footer row. Uppercase.

caption.purpose: The sentence under a story screenshot. Label face, sentence case.

code.purpose: Inline code in the label face on Surface. There is no monospace face.

note.purpose: The sentence on the index card; line height equals the card's 28px ruling. Typed versus handwritten is an open decision.

hand.purpose: The signature, in Signal, rotated -3deg. The ss03 capital H is an open decision.

shadows.name: card-on-desk
shadows.purpose: The index card only. Nothing else in the system casts a shadow.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing. Fast out, long settle, no bounce.

motion.name: t-control
motion.purpose: Hover and state changes on controls: colour shifts, the 3px nudge, the toggle closing.

motion.name: t-type
motion.purpose: Type-scale movement: the story wipe and the spiral's nudge.

motion.name: nudge
motion.purpose: The hover response for row questions, captions and the spiral.

motion.name: wipe
motion.purpose: An opened story reveals left to right.

motion.name: write
motion.purpose: The signature is written once on load when scripts and motion are both on.

motion.name: tilt
motion.purpose: Rotation of the index card. The signature sits at -3deg and "Keep in touch" at -2deg.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce every animation and transition collapses.

openDecisions: Desk-note card: built typed in Hyperlegible Sans Bold; handwriting there needs the owner's approval of the typed card or the sentences supplied in his own hand.
Signature capital H: uses the font's ss03 alternate and can read as a K; needs sign-off or a vector of the real signature.
og:image: still the previous site's social card; does not match this page.

narrative.overview:
The page is a signed letter whose postscript is a numbered log of questions. The ground is photocopy-grey paper with no chroma, the ink is near-black, and every division is a 1px ink rule with square corners. Three voices do all the talking: Hyperlegible Sans says things, Space Grotesk in tracked caps counts and labels things, and a felt-tip hand in Signal red-orange signs them. The feeling is the calm of an instrument that works, with the warmth of a note left on a desk.

Colour is livery, not decoration. Signal marks the hand, the row numbers and whatever is open or under the pointer. Hazard is a highlighter pulled behind inline links. Track is the focus ring. Nothing else on the page has a hue, apart from the full-colour screenshots held inside ink rules and one ruled index card.

The system is one hand-written static page: one stylesheet of custom properties, no framework, no build step. Stories open through native `<details>`, so the page works with scripts off. Light and dark themes follow `prefers-color-scheme` and swap seven tokens; nothing else changes. The page rejects cream or beige "artisanal" paper, gradient text, glass cards, glow effects, and mono-on-black terminal dark mode.
keyCharacteristics: Chroma-free grey ground, near-black ink, 1px ink rules, square corners throughout.
Three type voices with fixed jobs: say (Hyperlegible Sans), count (Space Grotesk caps), sign (Casimir Dunmore).
Three livery colours with fixed jobs: Signal for state and the hand, Hazard for the highlighter, Track for focus.
A full-width caps greeting, then a narrow letter column pushed right, then a full-width log.
Motion on one axis only: 3px nudges to the right and left-to-right wipes, no bounce.
Flat everywhere except one tilted index card, the only object that casts a shadow.

rules.name: The No-Chroma Ground Rule
rules.body: Paper, Surface, Ink and Muted carry zero chroma in both themes. The page ground is never tinted warm or cool. The index card is the single warm-white object.

rules.name: The Livery Rule
rules.body: Each colour has one job. Signal marks state and the hand. Hazard highlights links. Track rings focus. None of them fills a panel, a button or a background area.

rules.name: The Text-Token Rule
rules.body: Signal and Track are applied through their `-text` tokens, which change on dark. Hazard and the card colours are fixed across themes.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Hyperlegible Sans says things, Space Grotesk counts and labels things, the hand signs things. A fourth face is never added, and no voice does another's job.

rules.name: The Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase belongs to the greeting and to the label voice. Questions, sub-headings, the email and captions are sentence case.

rules.name: The Two Hands Rule
rules.body: The hand appears twice on a page, at word length: the signature and "Keep in touch". It is always Signal, always tilted, and never the only place a fact appears.

rules.name: The One Object Rule
rules.body: Only the index card casts a shadow, and only the card and the hand are tilted (card -1.4deg, signature -3deg, "Keep in touch" -2deg). Everything else is flat and square to the page.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Rules are 1px and Ink. They separate; they never box text in. The only framed things are images.

dos: Do keep Paper, Surface, Ink and Muted at zero chroma in both themes, and let rules use Ink.
Do give each colour its one job: Signal for state and the hand, Hazard behind links, Track for the focus ring.
Do use the `-text` tokens for Signal and Track so the dark theme stays above 4.5:1.
Do set anything that counts, labels or names in the label voice: Space Grotesk 500, 0.74rem, +0.06em, caps, tabular figures, slashed zero.
Do answer hover with the same pair everywhere: Signal colour and a 3px move to the right, 350ms, `cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)`.
Do frame screenshots in a 1px Ink rule and leave them in full colour.
Do build disclosure on native `<details>` so the page works with scripts off, and give every animation a reduced-motion path.
donts: Don't tint the page ground. No cream or beige paper; the index card is the only warm-white object.
Don't round a corner or add a shadow to anything but the index card.
Don't use Signal, Hazard or Track as a panel, button or section fill.
Don't set sentences in the hand, use it more than twice on a page, or let it be the only place a fact appears.
Don't set questions or sub-headings in caps; caps are for the greeting and the label voice.
Don't add a fourth typeface or a monospace face; code uses the label face on Surface.
Don't use gradient text, glass cards, glow effects, or mono-on-black terminal styling.
Don't add bounce, vertical slides or fades; motion is a rightward nudge or a left-to-right wipe.
